thread:
ria (product): Quick heads-up: we're opening a limited preview for the new Aster-1 dedicated GPU pools in af-west-1 (Lagos) and eu-west-3 (Lisbon). Opt-in only right now. :rocket:

miguel (eng-runtime): Preview capacity is small — ~4 racks per region. Expect better throughput on long-context workloads (5-10% latency improvement for many RLHF-style workloads, bigger for large-batch).

elena (infra): Aster-1 = 48GB FP8-friendly card with our custom kernel paths. It supports q4_0/q5_1 quant flows. For LLM-70B we saw ~1.8–2.2x throughput vs H100v1 in internal benchmarks.

devops-bot: Capacity update: pool:a-aster1-af-west1 created (4 nodes) and pool:a-aster1-eu-west-3 created (4 nodes).

rohit (sales): Thanks. What's the policy for reservations and how do we surface to customers?

ria (product): Reservation + docs are live on the console: https://console.redwood/internal/dedicated/aster1-preview — customers must opt-in via the form or ping @account-ops. We'll accept a handful of early partners.

olivia (support): SLA question: will Aster-1 be covered by the Dedicated SLA? Fallback behavior?

elena (infra): For the preview it's best-effort (no financial SLA yet). Runtime routing will attempt Aster-1 then fallback to H100v2 or the customers pinned model variant. Route order: aster1 -> h100v2 -> hosted-general.

miguel (eng-runtime): Note for engineering customers: kernel flags for FP8 need to be enabled. Platform will auto-apply for managed deployments, but if you roll custom kernels add `reserved_profile: aster1_fp8` to your deployment config. Example:
```yaml
deployment:
  model: redwood/llm-70b-quant
  reserved_profile: aster1_fp8
```

ria (product): Migration note: this preview is additive — we wont automatically move customer reservations from H100v2. If teams want assistance moving committed workloads, @account-ops can coordinate transition plans.

tammy (ops): Region routing to include Aster-1 will turn on by default next week. Orgs that want to opt-out can set `allow_pools: []` in org settings or ask ops to exclude the pool.

miguel (eng-runtime): Quick CLI helper: `redwood capacity status --region af-west-1 --pool aster1` — sample: `pool aster1: 4/4 nodes available, 0 draining`.

rohit (sales): I'll draft a short customer blurb and send to product for sign-off. :+1:

ria (product): Thanks — also heads-up to eng-oncall: we'll enable throttling of non-reserved burst capacity in af-west-1 starting Tue 00:00 UTC to keep the preview stable. Expect some non-reserved requests to be routed away.

eng-oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: throttle non-reserved burst in af-west-1 at 2070003600. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/aster1-preview-throttle

elena (infra): :eyes: I'll post the runbook and kernel notes into #eng-oncall and #eng-runtime.

ria (product): If you want early access for a customer, @mention me and include workload profile (qps, avg tokens, pinned model). We'll prioritize partners with deterministic performance needs.

miguel (eng-runtime): Any perf anomalies, tag #eng-runtime and include `redwood capacity status` output + request ids. We'll hotfix kernel knobs quickly during preview.

rohit (sales): Great — thanks team.

ria (product): Closing note: this is a preview; more regions and capacity will follow if stability and metrics look good. Feedback appreciated. :pray:
